`final class ResourceBuilder`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ResourceBuilder.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/ResourceBuilder.java)

Creates resources with shared default settings and a cache that makes two loads of the same input share their data.

## Description

[`Resource.of`](/reference/resources/resource/#Resource-factory-of) uses a default builder with linear filtering and a shared [`MemoryResourceCache`](/reference/resources/memoryresourcecache/).
Make your own when a group of resources needs other defaults or another cache ([Give a set of images the same settings](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/media/#give-a-set-of-images-the-same-settings)).

Every setting returns a new builder and leaves this one unchanged.

<a id="ResourceBuilder-method-of"></a>

### of

`Resource of(Object input)` 

Returns a handle on the resource of `input`: a texture of the application or another input that a resolver knows, otherwise an [`Asset`](/reference/resources/asset/), whose format is detected from its first bytes.
A path found nowhere gives a failed resource; an input of a type that nothing knows throws `IllegalArgumentException`.

<a id="ResourceBuilder-method-compute"></a>

### compute

`Resource compute(String uniqueId, Supplier<ResourceData> dataSupplier)` 

Returns a handle on the data cached under `uniqueId`, creating it with `dataSupplier` when the cache does not have it.
Use it in a resolver or for data you build yourself.

`Resource compute(String uniqueId, Supplier<ResourceData> dataSupplier, Consumer<Resource> onCreate)` 

Returns a handle on the data cached under `uniqueId`, creating it with `dataSupplier` when the cache does not have it, and calls `onCreate` with the handle when the data was created rather than found in the cache.

### remove

`this remove(ResourceData data)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

### reload

`this reload()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
